note: Nairobi day experiences listed on the live homepage and 1-day tour page. Details are short factual summaries.

experiences.name: Nairobi National Park
experiences.excerpt: Lions, rhinos and buffalo with a city skyline — the world's only wildlife capital national park, minutes from downtown.

experiences.name: Giraffe Centre
experiences.excerpt: Hand-feed endangered Rothschild's giraffes and learn about the breeding programme.

experiences.name: Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage
experiences.excerpt: Visit rescued baby elephants at the world-famous rehabilitation project during the public viewing hour.

experiences.name: Nairobi National Museum
experiences.excerpt: Kenya's natural and cultural heritage — fossils, birds, art and history under one roof.

experiences.name: Bomas of Kenya
experiences.excerpt: Traditional homesteads and energetic cultural dances from Kenya's communities.

experiences.name: Carnivore Restaurant
experiences.excerpt: Nairobi's legendary nyama-choma feast — meats carved tableside in a safari atmosphere.
